description:
Overlay skins, baskets and indices on one date axis. The data behind rust.wiki/skins/compare: one shared `dates` axis and a `series` entry per token with
`key`, `name`, `icon_url`, `is_basket`, `is_index` and `prices` aligned to the axis (null where that entry has
no data yet). Skin and basket entries are prices in cents (a basket is the plain average of its members'
prices); index entries are index levels rebased to 100. Spans over two years are downsampled to weekly points.
Cached for 24 hours per parameter combination.

end_date.description: Custom range end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Only read when range=custom.

entries.description: Comma-separated, up to 8: an `itemdefid` (that skin's price), `category:weapon` / `collection:Forest Raiders` / `item:shoes.boots` (the basket's average price) or `index:all` / `index:category:weapon` / `index:custom:123.456` (an index entry; custom ids joined with `.`).

range.description: Window: `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`, `4y`, `5y`, `all`, or `custom` with `start_date`/`end_date`. Spans over two years are downsampled to one point per week.

start_date.description: Custom range start (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Only read when range=custom.

trim_days.description: Mask each constituent's first N days of history (0-90) to drop launch-week volatility.

name: compare_market
title: Overlay skins, baskets and indices on one date axis
